lines.text: Do you know how the Statue of Liberty crossed the ocean? Not in one piece. In about three hundred fifty.
It was built in Paris, then taken apart into about three hundred fifty pieces.
They were packed into two hundred fourteen crates, and loaded onto a French navy ship.
In New York, the crates waited for months, until the pedestal was finished.
Then the pieces were riveted back onto an iron frame, and in eighteen eighty six, she was finally unveiled.
